biotools.summary: DoRothEA is a tool for exploring and analyzing transcriptional regulatory networks, particularly focusing on nucleus pulposus (NP) cells and their role in intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD). It facilitates the identification of transcription factors and their target genes, aiding in understanding the underlying molecular mechanisms of IVDD.
